findings.title: Duplicate task status mapping helpers
findings.issue: todoIcon(_:) and todoColor(_:) duplicate the same status-to-presentation mapping that taskIcon(_:) and taskColor(_:) implement later in the same changed unit.
findings.impact: Adding or renaming a task status now requires updating two separate helper pairs, and the mappings can drift between the inline checklist and the task panel.

findings.title: Duplicate diff rendering flow
findings.issue: editDiffView(_:) and writeDiffView(_:) repeat the same split-lines, large-output fallback, file path label, monospaced line rendering, padding, text selection, and rounded background sequence.
findings.impact: Future changes to diff presentation, truncation thresholds, or styling must be made in both branches and can diverge for edit and write tool output.

findings.title: Protocol width is in the minor band
findings.issue: LogViewerState declares 8 requirements, which falls in the ISP-1 minor width band of 6-8 requirements. The single project conformer, LogViewerViewModel, meaningfully implements all 8 requirements, so there is no coverage or cohesion violation.
findings.impact: The protocol is currently usable by its only conformer, but future conformers may be coupled to the full log viewer state surface even if they only need a subset.

findings.title: Concrete session dependency limits extension
findings.issue: LogViewerView accepts a concrete SessionManager and derives TTYBridge from it, so alternate session-control behavior must conform to that concrete type rather than a narrower abstraction.
findings.impact: The dependency is injected and therefore not sealed, but it leaves the view less open to alternate interactive-session implementations than the generic ViewModel boundary does.
findings.rule_source: OCP-2 Testability: 0 sealed points with 1-2 testable DIRECT INJECTED concrete dependencies is MINOR.

findings.title: View model performs several presentation-state actions
findings.issue: The unit performs five distinct verbs: resolves file URLs, formats role labels, loads messages, polls, and rebuilds derived state. The methods still serve one presentation-state stakeholder and remain in one cohesion group, so this stays within the SRP minor band.
findings.impact: Future changes to the same presentation-state workflow may increase pressure on the view model, but there is no structural multi-responsibility split yet.
findings.rule_source: SRP-1: 3+ verbs, 1 group, 1 stakeholder is MINOR.

findings.title: View contains multiple disjoint responsibility groups
findings.issue: LogViewerView has separate cohesion groups for screen/message rendering, PTY bridge input and prompts, navigation/file opening, and task progress display. Methods such as permissionPrompt(_:), askUserQuestionPrompt(_:toolID:), planApprovalPrompt(), inputField, and sendInput() operate on bridge/input prompt state, while taskPanelView/taskIcon/taskColor form a task-panel cluster and the message/tool renderers form another cluster.
findings.impact: Independent changes to prompt interaction, task progress UX, navigation, or message/tool rendering all require edits to the same view type, making regressions more likely as the screen grows.

findings.title: View performs many actions for multiple stakeholders
findings.issue: The unit performs 16 distinct verbs, including resolving, checking, formatting, calculating, rendering, composing, orchestrating, mapping, dispatching, diffing, prompting, sending, and summarizing. These map to multiple stakeholders: visual/message presentation, interactive session workflow, navigation/file-opening UX, and task progress UX.
findings.impact: The type has multiple independent reasons to change, so feature work in one workflow can affect unrelated rendering and interaction behavior.
findings.rule_source: SRP-1: 3+ verbs with 2+ stakeholders is SEVERE.

findings.title: Tool result view performs several display actions
findings.issue: The unit renders, toggles, and previews tool-result content. These actions are cohesive around one display stakeholder, so the issue remains minor.
findings.impact: Additional display behaviors in this type could push it toward a larger component, but the current methods still share one responsibility.
findings.rule_source: SRP-1: 3+ verbs, 1 group, 1 stakeholder is MINOR.

findings.description: Task.detached is created outside a SwiftUI .task modifier without storing a task handle or providing a cancellation path. The loaded SC-2 rule requires every Task or Task.detached outside SwiftUI .task to be stored and cancellable.

findings.title: View has no preview instantiation
findings.issue: StatusDot is a file-scope View struct, but no #Preview or PreviewProvider instantiates it anywhere in the module.
findings.impact: The component cannot be visually validated in Xcode previews.

findings.title: Literal fixed frame
findings.issue: StatusDot hardcodes both width and height with .frame(width: 6, height: 6).
findings.impact: Literal fixed dimensions bypass adaptive SwiftUI layout.

findings.title: View-returning property exceeds complexity thresholds
findings.issue: logContent contains nested conditional view builders and many child expressions; measured max nesting is 6 and expression count is 24, exceeding SUI-1 thresholds.
findings.impact: The view hierarchy is difficult to scan and should be decomposed into smaller SwiftUI views.

findings.title: View performs state transformation
findings.issue: taskPanelView filters vm.taskList to compute the completed count inside the SwiftUI view.
findings.impact: Business or derived state computation in the view makes the view less purely a function of already-prepared state.

findings.title: Nested child view has a long modifier chain
findings.issue: The nested Text(thinking) child chains six modifiers inside the ExpandableSection content closure.
findings.impact: Long nested modifier chains make view-builder closures harder to read and should be extracted.

findings.title: View has no preview instantiation
findings.issue: LogViewerView is a file-scope View struct, but no #Preview or PreviewProvider instantiates it anywhere in the module.
findings.impact: The full log viewer cannot be visually validated in Xcode previews.

findings.title: Literal fixed frame
findings.issue: taskPanelView applies .frame(height: 4) with a literal numeric height to the progress bar GeometryReader.
findings.impact: Literal fixed dimensions bypass adaptive SwiftUI layout.

findings.title: View has no preview instantiation
findings.issue: ExpandableSection is a file-scope View struct, but no #Preview or PreviewProvider instantiates it anywhere in the module.
findings.impact: The reusable disclosure component cannot be visually validated in Xcode previews.

findings.title: View transforms content into derived display state
findings.issue: ToolResultView splits content into lines and computes a truncated preview in init(content:).
findings.impact: Transformation logic in the view weakens view purity and makes the component responsible for preparing data.

findings.title: View has no preview instantiation
findings.issue: ToolResultView is a file-scope View struct, but no #Preview or PreviewProvider instantiates it anywhere in the module.
findings.impact: The tool-result renderer cannot be visually validated in Xcode previews.
